mentions.name: Careroute
mentions.description: This healthcare app triages people to the right site of care, estimates their visit cost with their insurance before they go, and lowers bills after the visit by having an AI voice agent negotiate on their behalf. Triage works for all regions, while cost estimates and bill negotiation are US-only.
mentions.problem: Patients often don't know the right site of care for their needs, face uncertainty about visit costs under their insurance, and receive high medical bills after visits.
mentions.audience: Patients and people seeking medical care.
